import { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { HelpPanelContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
export interface HelpPanelProps extends HelpPanelContract {
    tutorialContent?: ReactNode;
    onModeRequest?: (mode: 'help' | 'tutorial') => void;
    delegateRestoration?: boolean;
    showOpener?: boolean;
    showTopicTriggers?: boolean;
}
export declare function HelpPanel({ topics, open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, selectedTopicId, defaultSelectedTopicId, onTopicChange, mode, fallbackFocusId, tutorialContent, onModeRequest, delegateRestoration, showOpener, showTopicTriggers }: HelpPanelProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
